messages:
anya.newhire: Hey all, newbie question  I'm trying to get secrets access for the payment-ingest service. What's the right flow for Vault + KMS? Also, how do rotations actually happen (automatic vs manual)?

tyler.devex: Welcome Anya! :wave: Flow in short: Vault = runtime secrets, KMS = key management (envelope/encryption for state/backups). Open a request in #platform-requests using the secret_request template and include envs + approver for prod.

mona.security: Add: For prod you must list a business approver (PM/owner) and a security approver (me or my deputy). Rotation: prefer Vault dynamic secrets for DB credentials (auto-rotated via TTL). Static secrets default to 90d rotation and should be avoided where possible.

anya.newhire: Can you paste the request template? Also what's the expected turnaround for staging vs prod?

tyler.devex: Template (paste into ticket body):

```
secret_request:
  requester: anya.newhire
  service: payment-ingest
  envs: [dev, staging, prod]
  vault_paths:
    - secret/data/payment-ingest/dev: read
    - secret/data/payment-ingest/staging: read
    - secret/data/payment-ingest/prod: read
  kms_key: projects/redwood-prod/locations/global/keyRings/payments/cryptoKeys/payment-cmk
  use_dynamic_db: true
  approver: @mona.security (prod)
  reason: service needs DB creds for ingestion + GH Actions integration tests
```

mona.security: Turnaround: infra usually provisions staging in 1 business day, prod takes ~2-3 business days because of approvals and KMS IAM reviews. If you tag the PM + me in the ticket it speeds things up.

anya.newhire: For GH Actions, do we store secrets in GH or have actions talk to Vault live? Which is recommended?

tyler.devex: Recommended: use OIDC to authenticate GH Actions and mint short-lived Vault tokens. Avoid storing long-lived secrets in GitHub. We have examples in infra-shared/actions/vault-login.

mona.security: Also consider using Vault's transit engine if you need to encrypt PII before storing in other systems. KV engine is for storing secret values. Transit is crypto-only.

infra-bot: Ticket #PR-903 created (secret_request). Assigned to infra-ops. ETA staging: 1 business day, prod: 3 business days.

vault-bot: policy "svc-payment-ingest-staging" created and mounted at secret/data/payment-ingest/staging (audit-id: e9d4).

anya.newhire: One more: how do we do emergency rotation if a key/secret is compromised?

mona.security: Open an incident and tag @security immediately. We have an emergency rotation runbook (link: https://redwood.internal/security/runbooks/emergency-secret-rotation). Steps: revoke leases, rotate DB password via Vault dynamic or issue new static creds + update secrets, rotate CMK if needed (coordinate with infra).

tyler.devex: If you want a quick walkthrough I can schedule 20 min to show the infra-shared helpers and GH Actions snippets. Welcome aboard! :tada:

anya.newhire: Thanks — opening the ticket now and will ping here if I hit perms errors.
